title: Wren and the Well
author: Ada Joubert
blurb: Felix Brightwater, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
